texts:
Friday's final injury reports are in for Week 7. Seven fantasy players are out and four are true Sunday decisions.

Puka Nacua is questionable.

Lamar Jackson is questionable.

Zach Charbonnet is out.

Let's get into it.
#RamsHouse #RavensFlock #Seahawks

Puka Nacua (calf) left Thursday's practice early and sat out Friday. Tests showed a minor injury.

WR3 for me if he plays. Monitor the Rams' inactives at 2:55 PM ET and have a 4:25 PM backup ready.

Tyler Higbee played 83 percent of the snaps. TE10 for me.
#RamsHouse

Brock Bowers practiced in full Thursday and Friday and has no designation. My No. 1 tight end vs LAR.

Ashton Jeanty played 58 percent of the snaps in Week 6 and has no designation. RB15 for me this week, an RB2.
#RaiderNation

Lamar Jackson (ankle) was limited all week and says pain when he runs is the issue. Jesse Minter calls it a game-time decision.

QB17 for me if he plays, a streamer. Monitor the Ravens' inactives at 11:30 AM ET and have a top-12 quarterback ready.
#RavensFlock

Cincinnati comes off the bye with nobody on the injury report.

Ja'Marr Chase is my No. 2 receiver this week at BAL.

Chase Brown is RB14 for me, borderline RB1/RB2 this week.
#WhoDey

Zach Charbonnet (knee) was activated off PUP Thursday, then ruled out Friday. Mike Macdonald says there is no setback.

Emanuel Wilson played 46 snaps in Week 6. Pivot to him, RB30 for me vs KC, a high-end RB3 and a high-end flex play.
#Seahawks

Rashee Rice (hamstring, knee) did not practice all week and is out at SEA. Pivot to Xavier Worthy, WR31 for me, a low-end WR3 and a low-end flex play.

Travis Kelce was limited all week with the ankle but has no designation. TE8 for me.
#ChiefsKingdom

Jeremiyah Love (ankle) is out again vs DEN. Pivot to Tyler Allgeier, RB27 for me, a high-end RB3 and a high-end flex play.

Bam Knight ran 15 times for 80 in Week 6. RB35 for me, a low-end flex play.

Trey McBride is TE3 for me.
#BirdGang

Pat Surtain II (ankle) is questionable after three limited practices. Michael Wilson is WR24 for me, a WR2, with less room if Surtain plays.

Jonah Coleman is questionable and still needs activation off IR. J.K. Dobbins stays RB23, an RB2.
#BroncosCountry #BirdGang

David Montgomery (groin) is out vs NYG, and the bye follows.

Woody Marks played 78 percent of the snaps at JAX and every snap inside the 5. Pivot to him, RB16 for me, an RB2.
#HTownMade

Tank Dell (knee) is questionable, and DeMeco Ryans expects him to play for the first time since December 2024. Outside my top 50 receivers; sit him.

Malik Nabers drew 15 targets in Week 6. WR11 for me at HOU, borderline WR1/WR2 this week.
#HTownMade #NYGiants

Tyler Warren (groin) is out at MIN. Pivot to Kyle Pitts Sr., TE12 for me vs SF, a borderline start this week.

Keenan Allen drew 11 targets the last time Warren sat. WR33 for me, a low-end WR3 and a low-end flex play.
#ForTheShoe #DirtyBirds

Colts CB Sauce Gardner (calf) is out.

Justin Jefferson has no designation. WR9 for me vs IND.

T.J. Hockenson cleared the concussion protocol and practiced in full all week. TE14 for me, a borderline start this week.
#Skol #ForTheShoe

Jordan Mason (thumb) practiced in full and is questionable, but Minnesota still has to activate him off IR by Saturday. RB28 for me if he is active, a high-end RB3.

Aaron Jones Sr. is RB18 for me, an RB2.
#Skol

Breece Hall (quad) is questionable after two limited practices, and Aaron Glenn takes the call to Sunday.

If Hall sits, Braelon Allen is RB13 for me, borderline RB1/RB2. If Hall plays, Allen falls to the flex range. Monitor the Jets' inactives at 11:30 AM ET.
#JetUp

Miami has no skill player on the report.

Ollie Gordon II is RB20 for me at NYJ, an RB2.

Omar Cooper Jr. ran 28 of 33 routes in his first game off IR. WR32 for me, a low-end WR3 and a low-end flex play.
#PhinsUp #JetUp

Emeka Egbuka (concussion, foot) is out at CAR. Pivot to Chris Godwin Jr., full Friday, WR45 for me, a low-end flex play to a dart throw.

Baker Mayfield (thumb) is questionable, but Todd Bowles says he plays. QB22 for me, a streamer at best.
#GoBucs

Bucky Irving practiced in full Friday after the illness and has no designation. RB12 for me, borderline RB1/RB2 this week.

Chuba Hubbard played 93 percent of the snaps at PHI and practiced in full. RB11 for me, borderline RB1/RB2.
#GoBucs #KeepPounding

Rico Dowdle (knee) is questionable for Paris after two limited practices; Pittsburgh did not practice Friday. RB31 for me, a low-end RB3; sit him for any Tier 3 back.

Jaylen Warren had 14 carries to Dowdle's 7 at TB. RB8 for me.
#HereWeGo

Alvin Kamara was limited Thursday with the back and has no designation. RB25 for me vs PIT, a high-end RB3.

Kendre Miller ran 20 times at NYG. RB26 for me, a high-end flex play.

Inactives in Paris drop at 8:00 AM ET.
#Saints

Josh Jacobs has no designation, and Matt LaFleur says he is on track to play at DET once he is activated by Saturday. RB17 for me, an RB2.

Christian Watson was limited all week and has no designation. WR7 for me.

Jahmyr Gibbs is my No. 1 back.
#GoPackGo #OnePride

Mike Evans (ribs, Achilles) is out at ATL, and the bye follows. Pivot to Brandin Cooks, WR47 for me, a low-end flex play to a dart throw.

George Kittle had 5 for 69 and a TD Monday. TE2 for me.

Drake London is WR6 for me.
#FTTB #DirtyBirds

Quinshon Judkins practiced all three days after missing Week 6 and has no designation at TEN. RB40 for me, a low-end flex play to a dart throw.

Tony Pollard rested Thursday and has no designation. RB21 for me vs CLE, an RB2.
#DawgPound #TitanUp

Dallas and Philadelphia post their reports Saturday for Monday night.

Saquon Barkley practiced in full Thursday. RB29 for me in his first game back, a high-end RB3.

George Pickens was limited with the shoulder. WR18 for me, a WR2.
#FlyEaglesFly #DallasCowboys

Every designation, practice report and pivot is in Prep Notes on the site, and the Menu is refreshed with the outs.

Follow @FF_ChefHazy for Sunday's inactives and pivots, and like this if it saved your lineup.

https://fantasykitchenff.com/prep.html?week=7
